description: Persistent discovery inventory for veterinary oncology treatment trials. Every source is checked daily. If master_url is inaccessible or incomplete, official fallback_urls must be tried before the source is marked NOT CHECKED. Newly discovered official source pages are added even when their current lead is a duplicate, closed, ineligible or unresolved.

sources.name: Gamgee Australian canine cancer vaccine trial
sources.notes: Sponsor accepts Australian owner registrations and veterinarian referrals for MCT and osteosarcoma, but screening interest is not verified treatment enrollment. August 2026 founder interview reported ethics/regulatory approval for the multicentre study was still pending; sponsor does not publish an ethics identifier or participating treatment sites. Reconfirm activation with primary organizer before matching.

sources.name: PetTrials Australian veterinary clinical trial directory
sources.notes: Seven mixed-condition listings, only the current UQ appendicular osteosarcoma vaccine listing independently confirmed as actively recruiting cancer treatment. Murdoch immunotherapy is labeled coming soon without a current protocol or enrollment and cannot be matched. Verify every aggregator lead against its organizer.

sources.name: SASH clinical research
sources.notes: Hospital research overview mentions combination chemotherapy for aggressive mast cell tumors under examples of research, with no recruitment status, protocol page or owner application. Treat as a lead only, not a confirmed current trial.

sources.name: CanineCancer.org.au Australian Research State Guide
sources.notes: User-reported research directory has undated historical recruitment claims. Its multicenter auranofin osteosarcoma trial was published in 2020 (Endo-Munoz et al.). The NSW Kvax B-cell lymphoma announcement links a dated 26 November 2015 sponsor press release; the WA soft-tissue-sarcoma vaccine lead has no currently verified organizer enrollment, and a related Perth Veterinary Specialists/Curtin IL-2 plus anti-CD40 sarcoma study published results in 2022. Do not promote directory claims without a contemporary direct organizer protocol.

sources.name: MediPaws clinical research
sources.notes: Current roster and detailed splenic haemangiosarcoma protocol: University of Melbourne multicentre autologous vaccine plus doxorubicin, ethics project 35274. Sydney participating site actively enrolling after splenectomy; vaccine free, standard chemotherapy owner-paid. One multicentre record; discover other confirmed sites without duplicating protocol.

sources.name: Brisbane Veterinary Specialist Centre foundation projects
sources.notes: Foundation calls five themes current but protocol-level pages show soft tissue sarcoma tigilanol trial completed, SCC skin microbiome observational, and lymphoma half-body-irradiation past-tense outcome with no active enrolment. PET-CT osteosarcoma is diagnostic; prostate surgery research lacks current recruitment confirmation. Do not infer recruitment from foundation header.

sources.name: ANZCVS Veterinary Oncology news and Vet Science Week proceedings
sources.notes: Oncology chapter news points to a member-gated repository and current-trials information, but visible news includes legacy posts. Public 2025 proceedings at anzcvs.com.au/vsw-2025-proceedings/ include CAR-T canine osteosarcoma laboratory work (not owner enrollment), Sita Withers immune-profiling and lymphoma half-body irradiation. The downloadable 2026 Vet Science Week program at vetscienceweek.com.au/wp-content/uploads/2026/07/ANZCVS-2026-Program-Book-Website.pdf provides investigator/topic leads but not patient-enrollment protocols. Resolve every lead with a contemporary organizer recruitment page before matching.

sources.name: Bridge Animal Referral Center clinical trials
sources.notes: Official Edmonds, Washington trial roster. Gold nanoparticle photothermal treatment is recruiting in species- and tumor-specific cohorts; current roster does not publish funding. Intratumoral long-acting carboplatin for canine superficial SCC is recruiting and fully funded; BARC is matched as a verified open site while possible common-protocol LSU identity remains unresolved and LSU is non-matchable. Merge the records if the study teams confirm a shared protocol. EGFR/HER2 peptide vaccination is a MedVet-catalog study site; the older Gilvetmab combination is closed. Canine and feline paclitaxel/Paccal studies are closed for data review. Verify cohort-specific eligibility and funding at the protocol level. Rechecked 2026-09-29: current gold and SCC cohorts have no published sponsor, investigator or protocol ID; the separate older gold page conflicts on size/funding. BARC also names pulmonary carcinoma and high-grade MCT for its EGFR vaccine with records review; these site-only diagnoses must not be applied to MedVet sites.

sources.name: Vivesto Paccal Vet sponsor results and recruitment status
sources.notes: Sponsor reported feline dose-finding recruitment complete July 1, 2026 (21 cats), cat topline September 17, 2026, and canine splenic hemangiosarcoma pilot topline September 15, 2026 (26 dogs). Clinic directory lists both cohorts closed for data review. Older feline owner enrollment and sponsor project pages still link to applications; treat those as stale until a new cohort is explicitly confirmed by sponsor and recruiting site. Future dog pivotal planning is not current enrollment.

sources.name: Penn Vet Atherton Laboratory clinical trials
sources.notes: Current clinical-trials section lists autologous CAR T therapy for canine histiocytic sarcoma and mattath@upenn.edu. On 2026-09-29, investigator Matthew Atherton directly confirmed open but limited enrollment, measurable disease required, archived tissue usable for STEAP1 screening, prior treatments allowed and concurrent chemotherapy excluded. Owner-provided prior consent form identifies POAP735 / IACUC807805 / IBC22-287 & 25-312 and study coverage; Penn says the form is being revised. Ryan Hospital site is 3900 Spruce Street, Philadelphia, PA 19104. This HS CAR-T protocol is separate from bendamustine for relapsed lymphoma. Bendamustine remains needs_reconfirmation; its absence from the current trials section does not establish closure.

sources.name: Canine Cancer Alliance research and study-status pages
sources.notes: Secondary official funder and study-status source. Use it to discover sponsor-supported protocols and reconcile site status, but verify treatment, eligibility, funding and current enrollment with the direct sponsor or treatment center. Current directions requiring primary-center confirmation include B7-H3 CAR-T for hemangiosarcoma, Immunocidin solid-tumor protocols, immune-checkpoint combinations, and IL-12 solid-tumor studies. The EGFR/HER2 status page is maintained as the protocol location roster; site-specific details still require the named center.
